body:
[12000 screenshots](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ez64fGINSUY)

i made this texture pack in 2021-2022 and then quit video games. but i have played a bit recently with some friends and decided to finish the new stuff and get everything about 100%. it was posted here before too but i deleted it, i tried to find some of the original screenshots, and i remade the video it had but longer, when the song changes thats stuff from 2025

there is also some mod support and an old 1.12 version if anyone wants that, also note blocks and enchanted book textures work now without optifine, but the pack looks best with optifine on with all the custom things enabled and fog on 0.2
